text: １０ぽんの　あしを　くねらせて　およぐ。

structure.jp: １０ぽんの　あしを　くねらせて

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: くねらせて　およぐ
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next; here the first action shows the way the second is done. くねらせて およぐ = 'swims by wriggling them'.

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: This ending means making something do the action. くねる is 'to wriggle', so あしを くねらせて = 'making its tentacles wriggle'.
